atoms.name: submit_step1_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only authors of the submission may submit step-1 material while step 1 is open.

atoms.name: submit_full_paper_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only authors with step-2 credentials may upload full papers during step 2.

atoms.name: update_step1_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only authors with step-2 credentials may correct step-1 information during step 2.

atoms.name: camera_ready_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only authors of selected submissions may submit camera-ready versions after review.

atoms.name: download_assigned_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only assigned non-conflicted reviewers may download papers after distribution.

atoms.name: display_abstract_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only assigned non-conflicted reviewers may display abstracts after distribution.

atoms.name: submit_review_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only assigned non-conflicted reviewers may submit reviews while review is open.

atoms.name: update_review_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only assigned non-conflicted reviewers may update reviews while review is open.

atoms.name: read_other_reviews_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Reviewers may read other reviewers' reviews only after submitting their own review for the paper.

atoms.name: volunteer_conflicting_paper_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Reviewers may volunteer for conflicting-review papers only after finishing assigned reviews and absent conflict of interest.

atoms.name: monitor_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only chair/PCC roles may monitor review overviews.

atoms.name: ask_additional_reviewer_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Only PCC may ask additional reviewers for low-expertise papers.

atoms.name: directory_access_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Reviewer directories are protected by owner or allowed-user list.

atoms.name: review_file_access_ceiling
atoms.plain_english_summary: Review files are protected by the file and directory allowed-user lists.

atoms.name: author_submit_step1_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: Authors must be able to submit step-1 material during step 1.

atoms.name: reviewer_read_other_reviews_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: A reviewer who has submitted their own review must be able to read other reviews for that paper.

atoms.name: pcc_ask_additional_reviewer_floor
atoms.plain_english_summary: PCC must be able to ask for additional review on low-expertise papers.

atoms.name: liveness_submit_step1
atoms.plain_english_summary: At least one author step-1 submission request should be possible.

atoms.name: liveness_submit_review
atoms.plain_english_summary: At least one reviewer submit-review request should be possible.

atoms.name: liveness_monitor
atoms.plain_english_summary: At least one chair/PCC monitoring request should be possible.
